en.hubeali: H 14830 – Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad Bin Isa, from Rabi’e with an unbroken chain, has narrated the following: Aliasws Bin Al-Husaynasws has said:

‘By Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! There will not come out any one from us<sup>asws</sup> before the coming out of Al-Qaim<sup>asws</sup> except that his example would be of a nestling trying to come out from its nest before its wings have been formed, so the young boys grab hold of it and play with it’.
en.sarwar: 383. Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad Bin Isa, from Rabi’e with an unbroken chain, has narrated the following: Ali (a.s.) Bin Al-Husayn (a.s.) has said:

‘By Allah (azwj)! There will not come out any one from us (a.s.) before the coming out of Al-Qaim (a.s.) except that his example would be of a nestling trying to come out from its nest before its wings have been formed, so the young boys grab hold of it and play with it’.
